title: Knotty By Nature and Feeling TipSea Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
h1: Knotty By Nature and Feeling TipSea
meta_description: Looking for a premiere Seaside home with a pool, look no more. Check out the stunning renovation at Knotty by Nature, located just six houses from the beach on Savannah Street in Seaside, Florida.
description_expanded: 60 SAVANNAH STREETPremier Seaside Retreat with a Private PoolIf you’re searching for a premier Seaside, Florida vacation home with a private pool, Knotty by Nature delivers an exceptional coastal escape. Located just six houses from the beach on Savannah Street, this beautifully renovated, single-story home offers luxury, comfort, and an unbeatable location in the heart of Seaside. Extensive renovations throughout the home include all-new designer furnishings, a modern gourmet kitchen, and fully updated bathrooms—creating a fresh, upscale setting for your beach getaway.Outdoor Living Designed for EntertainingOutdoor living is a highlight at Knotty by Nature. The expansive L-shaped wrap-around porch is thoughtfully furnished with a stylish lounge area, a wall-mounted Smart TV, and multiple seating zones ideal for relaxing or entertaining. An outdoor dining area for four, a charming front-entry seating nook, and a convenient ice maker make this space perfect for everything from casual breakfasts to evening wine under the stars. The home’s seamless indoor-outdoor flow truly elevates the Seaside lifestyle.Open-Concept Living and Gourmet KitchenInside, the open-concept floor plan blends the living, dining, and kitchen areas into one inviting space. The living room features a large sectional sofa, designer décor, a Samsung 4K Smart TV with basic cable, and a Sonos soundbar for elevated entertainment. The adjacent chef’s kitchen is designed for gathering, with a marble center island offering bar seating for three, a built-in Sub-Zero refrigerator, a Wolf four-burner gas range with center griddle, and a Bosch dishwasher. Just beyond, the dining area comfortably seats eight and overlooks the screened porch through a wall of glass windows, filling the space with natural light.Thoughtfully Designed Bedrooms and BathsKnotty by Nature offers sleeping accommodations for families and groups, with two king bedrooms and a custom-built queen-over-queen bunk room that sleeps four. The front king bedroom includes direct porch access, custom storage, beadboard paneling, and a walk-in closet, with access to a beautifully renovated shared bathroom featuring a deep soaking tub, glass-enclosed rain shower, double vanity, and cheerful nautical tile accents.The bunk room is a guest favorite, designed with crisp white beadboard walls, a large flat-screen Smart TV, a jumbo bean bag for lounging, and a walk-in closet—ideal for kids or teens. At the rear of the home, the king primary suite offers a private retreat with double-door access overlooking the pool and deck, a Smart TV with Sonos soundbar, a walk-in closet, and a spa-like ensuite bathroom with a double vanity and glass-enclosed rain shower.Private Pool and Guest Cottage CombinationThe crown jewel of Knotty by Nature is the private backyard deck with its exclusive plunge pool—one of the few homes in Seaside to offer this rare luxury. This combination listing includes the rear guest cottage Feeling TipSea, a stunning renovation that sleeps an additional four guests and features a king primary bedroom and a queen sleeper sofa. Together, these two properties create an exceptional Seaside retreat with space, privacy, and resort-style amenities.Perfectly located near the beach, pools, and town center, Knotty by Nature offers a truly elevated Seaside, FL vacation experience.• Spring & Spring Break 5 Nt, Summer Sat to Sat 7Nt, 3 Nt fall, 2 Nt winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.(Pool can be heated for $35 a day, from Oct 1 - May 1 to 85 degrees.FEATURESPrivate Seaside Residential Beach Access at Savannah Pavilion351 feet or a 2-minute walk to beach accessPrivate plunge pool with patio ice makerGourmet kitchen with Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf gas range with griddle, and Bosch dishwasherSamsung 4K Smart TV with basic cable and Sonos soundbarBoosted high-speed WiFi up to 500 MBPrivate driveway with parking for two vehiclesPeacock Alley premium linens – fresh, luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedTwo parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes; a golf cart is considered a carGolf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
